Infrastructure as Code

प्लेबुक टास्क

An individual, defined automation step within an orchestration playbook (such as Ansible or SaltStack), specifying actions to be performed on target systems.

In this glossary, प्लेबुक टास्क refers to: An individual, defined automation step within an orchestration playbook (such as Ansible or SaltStack), specifying actions to be performed on target systems.

How is प्लेबुक टास्क used in IT and DevOps?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ITIL v4, AWS Well-Architected Framework, Kubernetes Documentation, CNCF and published by Protermify IT/DevOps as a static IT and DevOps reference page.

Definition

An individual, defined automation step within an orchestration playbook (such as Ansible or SaltStack), specifying actions to be performed on target systems.

Operational example

Each playbook task in Ansible describes a single operation, such as installing a package or copying files to a server.
